recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, minimalist illustration featuring a stylized female figure in a black gown with vibrant red hair, framed by a continuous geometric line that integrates with custom diagonal lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: The red hair acts as the primary focal point against the neutral background.
The black silhouette of the dress anchors the left side of the composition.
The diagonal text orientation creates a dynamic tension with the vertical figure.
A single continuous black line defines the frame and interacts with the typography.
coreInvariants: High-contrast palette of black, white, and red
Minimalist facial features with open-mouth expression

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The figure is positioned on the left third, scaled to nearly the full height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid black mass of the dress and the vibrant red hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red hair, follows the curve of the body down to the shoes, then moves up the diagonal text line to the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive off-white negative space on the right side balances the heavy silhouette on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white/Cream background for a vintage paper feel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for the silhouette, frame, and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the hair and small details like lips and nails.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between black and white; high saturation on the red accent.

letterConstructionRules: Monolinear stroke width matching the frame line
Open counters and simplified geometric forms
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'e' features a horizontal crossbar that aligns with the diagonal flow
Ascenders and descenders are truncated to fit within the geometric frame
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family or custom lettering only to maintain Art Deco minimalism.

candidateDirections.reason: Perfectly circular bowls and geometric purity.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a minimalist illustration of a woman with voluminous curly red hair and a black gown on a cream background. Use a thin black geometric line to frame the composition, leaving a large diagonal gap on the right for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom geometric lowercase lettering on a 45-degree diagonal within the frame gap. Ensure the stroke weight of the letters matches the frame line exactly.

verificationChecks: Is the hair the only source of vibrant color?
Does the typography follow a consistent 45-degree angle?
Is the frame line continuous and monolinear?
Are the letterforms perfectly geometric (circles and straight lines)?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the geometric frame line

mustAchieve: Consistent line weight between text and frame

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is lowercase and geometric.
Ensure the red hair is high-saturation against the cream.
Verify the silhouette is solid black without internal detail.
Confirm the diagonal alignment of the text block.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast silhouette with a single primary color accent, framed by a monolinear geometric border that dictates the path of custom diagonal sans-serif lettering.
